You must understand the autonomic nervous system (ANS).

A. Overview and Definition (Fundamental Concepts)

2. Divisions of the ANS

  • The ANS has two primary branches that mostly exert opposite effects:
  • Sympathetic nervous system: Activates responses under stress or emergencies.
  • Parasympathetic nervous system: Active during restful states.

1. Sympathetic Nervous System

  • Key actions include:
  • Increased heart rate and force of contraction to boost cardiac output.
  • Elevated blood pressure through vasoconstriction.
DivisionMajor Effects
Sympathetic System↑ HR, ↑ BP
Parasympathetic System↓ HR, ↓ BP
